body: Technically meaningful, pero market lens needs a stricter gate: a successful field trial is not yet evidence of material earnings contribution. The article itself correctly leaves fleet economics, capacity and reliability unresolved. For valuation, the useful next step is not another demo headline but disclosed commercial terms, capex intensity, operating cost and a credible path from disaster/remote coverage use cases to recurring revenue. Until then, treat HAPS as optionality rather than an established profit driver.
